From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

English

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
misunderstand
Wikipedia

Etymology

[edit]

From Middle English mys-understanden, equivalent to mis- +‎ understand.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Received Pronunciation) IPA(key): /mɪs.ʌn.də(ɹ)ˈstænd/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • (Received Pronunciation) IPA(key): /mɪs.ʌn.dɚˈstænd/
  • Audio (US):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ænd

Verb

[edit]

misunderstand (third-person singular simple present misunderstands, present participle misunderstanding, simple past and past participle misunderstood)

  1. (transitive) To understand incorrectly, while believing one has understood correctly.
    • 2024, NTSB, Intersection Crash Between Passenger Car and Combination Vehicle, Tishomingo, Oklahoma, March 22, 2022:
      We found that teen drivers and the public largely misunderstand the legal status of cannabis use and do not fully recognize the risks of cannabis-impaired driving.

Synonyms

[edit]
  • take (something) the wrong way

Derived terms

[edit]
  • misunderestimate
  • misunderstandable
  • misunderstander
  • misunderstanding
  • misunderstandingly
